title: US Stocks Fall as Traders Prep for Nvidia Earnings, Jackson Hole
summary: US stocks fell Monday as investors positioned ahead of a pivotal week: Nvidia Q2 earnings (Aug 26, consensus revenue +97% YoY), Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech (Aug 28), and a PCE inflation reading. Alibaba dropped 9.1% in Hong Kong after announcing HK$80B share placement, dragging Hang Seng Tech Index down 3.6%. Chip stocks AMD and Micron rose 4.9% and 2.5% respectively Tuesday as semiconductor sentiment improved.
why: Bloomberg对本周市场全景综述：英伟达+Jackson Hole+PCE三重催化剂叠加，全球风险资产均受影响；阿里配售拖累恒生科技已造成港股波动，本周末Warsh发言将为美股定向。

title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await key inflation report, Nvidia earnings: Live updates
summary: Aug 26 market open: stock futures flat as markets await Nvidia Q2 results (after close) and PCE inflation data. Yesterday (Aug 25): S&P 500 +0.32% to 7,677, Nasdaq +0.66% to 26,151; 10-year Treasury yield -7bp to 4.625%; Bitcoin crossed $80,000; AMD +4.9%, Micron +2.5% on AI optimism ahead of Nvidia. Dick's Sporting Goods plunged 30% on weak results.
why: 今日（8月26日）市场开盘数据：美股期货平稳，英伟达收盘后财报、PCE通胀数据为两大风险点；昨日半导体板块领涨、美债收益率下行，为sell put仓位提供短线支撑。
